purpose: Verify production orchestration, lifecycle isolation and bounded cost after the independent SUPPORTS pre-audit router passed calibration and zero-publication replay.
dirtyWorktreeDisclosure: The experiment freezes exact file hashes because Goal0-Goal4 work is intentionally uncommitted in the shared dirty worktree.

frozenInputs.sourceSelection: The first four lexicographically sorted Markdown files in the 140-source frozen compilation corpus

machineAcceptance: all four Sources finish without compile failure
generated = selectedBeforeTypeRouter + deferredByAuditBudget for every Source
selectedBeforeTypeRouter = fullAuditSelected + deferredByTypeRouter for every Source
fullAuditSelected = auditedPassed + quarantined for every Source
auditedPassed = canonicalPublished + deferredByGraphDiversity for every Source
every router ledger decision has relation type SUPPORTS and publicationState CANDIDATE
every DEFER_BY_TYPE_ROUTER Relation has zero canonical and quarantine publication exposure
non-SUPPORTS candidates bypass the router and remain in full audit
all router parse results are valid or invalid singleton results fail open to full audit
all canonical Relation endpoints and evidence resolve
total model usage does not exceed 300000 tokens
manualAcceptance: review every SUPPORTS candidate deferred by the router; no plausible true support may be silently deferred
review every canonical cross-material Relation for existence, type, direction, conditions and evidence
maximum harmful or unfaithful canonical Relations is zero

decisionRules.machineOrManualGateFails: Disable production router integration; retain artifacts as a rejected canary.
decisionRules.allGatesPass: Accept Goal4 router lifecycle and proceed to the next product-value goal; do not scale compilation merely to collect more router counts.
decisionRules.noSupportPressureObserved: Canary is orchestration-only evidence; retain frozen replay as the cost evidence and do not claim online optimization validation.

interpretationLimits: A deferred Relation remains a candidate scheduling artifact, not a negative truth label.
The router has no publication authority and does not replace the semantic audit.
This canary validates four frozen sources only; it is not evidence of universal domain precision.
